name: ADIL KALYANPUR
bio:
Career Overview: Playing Style: A tall, wiry player with a strong serve and aggressive baseline game, showing promise in both singles and doubles.
Career-High ATP Singles Ranking: #842 (October 14, 2024), Career-High ATP Doubles Ranking: #870 (February 24, 2025).
Best Grand Slam Singles Performance: Yet to play in a Grand Slam main draw.
Notable Achievements: ITF Success: Won 1 ITF Futures doubles title (2023 M15 Nakhon Si Thammarat with Nitin Kumar Sinha). Biggest Singles Win: Defeated World No. 512 Siddhant Banthia at the 2024 ITF M15 Chandigarh. Junior Success: Reached a career-high ITF Junior Ranking of #93 (2017) and led India to a 12th-place finish at the 2016 Junior Davis Cup World Finals. Davis Cup & National Representation: Named reserve player for India’s Davis Cup team in 2016 (aged 16), yet to debut in a live rubber.
Other Highlights: Trained at the Rafa Nadal Academy in Mallorca (2016-2018). Reached the doubles quarterfinals at the 2025 ITF M25 Chennai with S.D. Prajwal Dev. Aims to break into the Top 500 by 2026.
Adil is a steady riser in Indian tennis, leveraging his junior pedigree for pro success. 🎾🇮🇳
